in_marathi.name: Hiteshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे City of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiteshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiteshi is a Sanskrit female name derived from the term 'Hid' meaning sun and 'Eeshi' meaning goddess. It represents the city of God, where the goddess resides. The name is associated with power, wisdom, and divine grace.
